candidates.snippet: 1922: Nobel Prize in Physics - Awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics for his research on the structure of atoms and the radiation emanating from them. 1921: Establishment of Institute of Theoretical Physics - Became director of the Institute of Theoretical Physics at the University of Copenhagen, a center for quantum mechanics research. 1913: Publication of Atomic Theory - Published his groundbreaking model of the atom, introducing the concept of quantized electron orbits. 1903: Early Education - Enrolled at the University of Copenhagen to study physics, laying the groundwork for his future scientific career.
